    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                rr, cc = stack.pop()
                cells.append((rr, cc))
                for nr, nc in ((rr-1,cc),(rr+1,cc),(rr,cc-1),(rr,cc+1)):
                    if 0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and (nr,nc) not in seen and grid[nr][nc] == color:
                        seen.add((nr,nc))
                        stack.append((nr,nc))
            minr = min(x for x,y in cells)
            minc = min(y for x,y in cells)
            maxr = max(x for x,y in cells)
            maxc = max(y for x,y in cells)
            shape = [(x-minr,y-minc) for x,y in cells]
            objects.append((minc, minr, color, maxr-minr+1, maxc-minc+1, shape))

    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    top = left = 0
    prev = None
    for _, _, color, oh, ow, shape in objects:

            left += prev[4] - 1

                out[top+dr][left+dc] = color
        prev = (_, _, color, oh, ow, shape)
